info.name: MariStay API
info.description:
MariStay: Hotel Management and Digital Guest Services System — ITEC 116 Final Project (Geero Andrei E. Reyes, BSIT 4C).

How to use:
1. Import this collection and MariStay.postman_environment.json; select the "MariStay Local" environment.
2. Set the environment variable `demoPassword` to the SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD from your local .env (never commit it).
3. Start the API (npm run start:dev) and run folder 1 to log in every role.
4. Run the folders in order (folder 9 continues the stay created in folder 6). Folder 11 ends with the rate-limit test.

Payment, SMS/e-mail and smart-lock integrations are SIMULATED.
